ios.desc:
What should we do today?
Connective is the app to discover and create plans in your city. Events, fairs, courses, outings, sports and reunions: everything there is to do near you, all in one place.

How many plans have you missed because you didn't hear about them? With Connective, that's over.

OPEN THE MAP AND EXPLORE YOUR CITY
Everything happening near you, on a map. Filter by interest, choose the distance and find your next plan in seconds.

CAN'T FIND YOUR PLAN? CREATE IT
Post a reunion, a class or an event in just 5 steps: info, location, date, participants and price.

BYE-BYE, WHATSAPP GROUP
Every plan has its own chat with the participants to coordinate everything.

INVITE IN ONE TAP
Share your plan with a QR code, flyer or link. Add it to your calendar and open it in Google Maps.

MOMENTS
Upload photos from every get-together and relive your plans.

FOR ORGANIZERS
There's always someone looking for exactly what you know how to do. On social media, only people who already know you can see you; on Connective, your whole city discovers you. Charge for your activity and keep 100%: zero commission for organizers, always.

CONNECTIVE PLUS
Connective is free. If you organize often, Plus lets you create ongoing activities and classes with fixed days and times, and feature your plans so more people see them.

Download Connective for free and find your next plan.

Terms of Use (EULA): http://www.apple.com/legal/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula
